name: Manual Frame Assist
description: Self-adjusting spam smoothing: learns your click rhythm and evens out your real clicks in every gamemode.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Enable manual frame assistance during gameplay.

activation-cps.name: Activation CPS
activation-cps.description: Your real click speed (CPS) at which spam smoothing turns on. Below this, input is untouched.

smoothing.name: Smoothing
smoothing.description: How strongly early clicks are evened out (up to a few ms). 0 = only stop dropped clicks, 100 = strongest.
